description:
We are seeking dedicated and compassionate Registered Nurses (RNs) to join a premier home health agency in Billings, MT. This is an excellent opportunity for RNs looking for flexibility, with both full-time and part-time positions available, offering a highly competitive salary range.

In this role, you will provide high-quality, patient-centered care in the comfort of patients' homes, managing a diverse caseload and utilizing your clinical expertise to promote health and independence. If you are a self-motivated RN with a passion for home health and a desire to make a significant impact on patient lives, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Montana
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in home health or acute care setting
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $125,000, based on experience and contract type (Full-time or Part-time).
